review_method: Results retained from the final executed read-only consistency review; hashes captured when saving this record. Native files were opened or decoded without rewriting or regenerating CAD, drawings or renders. No test suite was rerun.
scope: Inventory of all 54 individual STEP/STL component pairs and all six named assembly STEP/STL pairs.
Current CAD validation and clearance source/trajectory hash bindings.
Native FreeCAD ZIP CRC and all 54 saved BRep solids; aggregate volume and bounding-box comparison against the current home STEP.
Retained independent FreeCAD six-pose bounding boxes compared with current CAD validation bounding boxes.
Saved native Blender home scene opened read-only; all 54 robot mesh names, vertex/triangle counts, local vertices and home transforms compared against the current mesh manifest.
Current local mesh component bounding boxes and all six binary assembly STL structures/bounding boxes compared with CAD properties.
Nine PNG renders decoded; three SVG drawings parsed; drawing PDF header, trailer and three page objects checked.
SHA-256 source and presentation copies for 139 CAD-related artifacts checked against the organization manifest.
limitations: This consistency review does not rerun every STEP component reimport, exhaustive collision analysis or continuous collision proof. Existing generated CAD and clearance evidence retains its stated acceptance scope.

FreeCAD, Blender, render and mesh records do not contain intrinsic source-hash bindings; the direct saved-native comparisons and this file hash inventory establish consistency for these checked release bytes.

SVG/PDF/PNG checks in this release review establish file readability and retained dimensions, not a repeated visual layout review. Visual review was completed during the preceding generation workflow.
Geometry remains a digital concept with simplified motor, gearbox and bearing interiors. This review does not establish hardware, manufacturing, functional safety or performance certification.
